Method of Attack: MacSpy: Mac spyware delivered via Malware-as-a-Service portal; spyware payload not digitally signed, triggers security alerts; code appears copy-pasted from Stack Overflow

MacRansom: Ransomware delivered via Malware-as-a-Service portal; uses symmetric encryption with keys included in source code; manual client approval and ransomware sample building; no C&C communication; no Tor-based payment panel, payment via email; ransomware file not digitally signed, triggers security alerts
Attack Vector: Malware-as-a-Service portals on the Dark Web requiring contact with malware author for demo packages and negotiation
Indicators of Compromise: Dark Web portals named MacSpy and MacRansom launched May 25, 2017
Ransomware samples manually built and distributed via email contact
Spyware and ransomware files not digitally signed, triggering macOS security alerts
